recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, overexposed close-up portrait of a smiling man, set against a bright white background featuring diagonally repeating ghosted typography and bold, outlined foreground text.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject occupies the right two-thirds with an extreme close-up crop.
Background text repeats at a 45-degree angle to create a rhythmic pattern.
Foreground text is anchored at the bottom left, overlapping the subject's chin.
Warm skin tones contrast against a sterile, high-key white environment.
coreInvariants: Extreme overexposure on the subject's highlights.
Diagonal repetition of background text at low opacity.
Heavy black outlines on the primary foreground typography.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Extreme close-up, right-aligned, filling roughly 60% of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bold, gold-filled foreground text at the bottom left.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the subject's smile, move down to the primary text, then follow the diagonal background pattern upward.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: High-key white space on the left side, partially filled with ghosted text.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep browns and blacks in the subject's features and text outlines.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Warm gold/ochre fill for the primary text and skin mid-tones.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value, high contrast, with moderate saturation in the warm tones.

letterConstructionRules: Slanted (italic) for a sense of speed and energy.
Tight kerning with characters nearly touching.
characterSpecificRedesigns: Primary text features a double outline (inner white, outer black).
Secondary text is smaller, solid black, and placed directly underneath.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Same font family used for primary and secondary text, varying only in scale and color.
graphicDevices: Diagonal ghosting: Background text repeated at 10-15% opacity.
High-key bloom: Soft glow on the edges of the subject.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy weight and condensed nature.
Captures the Y2K geometric tech-pop feel.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-key, overexposed portrait of a man smiling broadly, positioned on the right. The background should be pure white with a soft bloom effect on the subject's skin. Add a diagonal pattern of faint, light-tan repeating text at a 45-degree angle across the left side.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a large, bold, italicized sans-serif title in the bottom left corner with a gold fill and a thick black outline. Place a smaller, solid black subtitle directly below it in the same font style.

verificationChecks: Is the subject's face significantly overexposed?
Is the background text repeating diagonally?
Does the main text have a prominent black outline?

adjustableVariables: Angle of the diagonal text pattern
mustRedesign: Specific facial identity of the man
postGenerationChecks: Check for high-key white levels in background.
Ensure text is italicized and bold.
Verify diagonal repetition of background elements.
Confirm subject is cropped as an extreme close-up.
recipe.reuseFormula: High-key overexposed portrait + diagonal ghosted background text + bold outlined italic display type.
